decisions.reason: As a large established manufacturer, we would usually retain a thermoforming-related blank with its own product page because it fits core materials capabilities and shows at least two years of active marketing support.
This PETG thermoforming blank appears close to the firm's core product and production base, so unless margins were clearly disappointing we would be inclined to keep it in the portfolio.

The UV-curing lacquer looks more like a supporting niche product with lighter website emphasis, so it has a higher pruning risk but would still likely be kept if it complements existing customers' workflows.

Although custom hearing protection earmolds are somewhat more specialized and labor-intensive, this line survived while another earmold line disappeared, which suggests enough strategic or commercial value to keep it.
